(407)༄༅/ /sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu'i lo rgyus bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (407)༄༅// sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu'i lo rgyus bzhugs so//

(408)༄༅// na mo gu ru/ bka' brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lus med mkha' 'gro ma la bzod par gsol// yi dam lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// lus med mkha' 'gro ma la bzod par gsol// chos skyong srung ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// lus med mkha' 'gro ma la bzod par gsol// snyan rgyud yi ge med pa la// bdag gis yi ger bris pa 'di// lus med mkha' 'gro khyed la bzod par gsol// bdag shes rab chung ba ma lags kyang*// snyigs mar phan phyir yi ger bris// bsgom long med par sangs rgyas pa'i// gdams ngag 'di yi lo rgyus ni// te lo sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon// pho de bde mchog dngos su byon// shing sha ba'i sdong po'i rtsa na bzhugs pa'i dus su// mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan byung ste// nub phyogs o rgyan nas// yid bzhin nor bu rnam gsum dang*// lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor rnams lon nas// nam mkha' la 'phur nas gtsug gi nor bu'i dgon par byon nas// nā ro ri ri ka so ri la sogs pa'i grub chen rnams la// thabs dang brda'i sgo nas snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag gnang bas (409)brda dang don go bas// chos phyir srog 'dor nus pa byung ste// bla ma shin tu mnyes yod rtsa na nyin gcig bye ngos shig na// me'i 'obs rgya che la gting ring ba gcig 'dug ste// de'i nang na mi shin tu mang ba grangs kyis mi chod pa 'dug pa la// mi long ba brgya'i nang na ma long ba re re tsam 'dug pa la// bud med mi sdug pa cig ga nas byung cha med par byung nas// mi mig yod pa de tsho la lag pa g.yug ste/ lag pas la kha yar cig steng du thon song*/ kha yar steng du thon pa'i grabs 'jug gin 'dug /bshad pa pa re bu re mang po gtong yin 'dug kyang dmus long rnams kyis ma go /der me 'obs nang gi mi de rnams la sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa 'dug pas bla mas bud med de la mi rnams mi 'don pa ci yin byas pas/

bud med de na re/ mi de tsho mi 'don pa de khyod yin mod zer nas mo khros bsdad 'dug pas// bla ma'i thugs dgongs la 'di tsho brda ru 'dug snyam ste// 'obs de phyi snod kyi 'jig rten du go /mi de tsho nang bcud kyi sems can du go /'obs nang thams cad mes khebs pa de 'khor (410)ba'i sdug bsngal du go /mi mig ma long ba de tsho skal ldan sbyangs pa sngon du song ba rnams su go /mig long ba de tsho sbyangs pa sngon du ma song ba chos kyi bag chags med pa dmus long lta bur go /mig yod pa rnams la bud med des mdzub g.yugs byed pa de dang rang gi brda chos su go /mdzub g.yug byas kyang mi mthong ba de tsho sbyangs pa sngon du ma song ba dmus long lta bur go /mdzub g.yug byas pas mthong la steng du thon pa de tsho nga rang gi slob ma grub chen rnams su go /mdzub g.yug byas nas da dung 'don pa'i grabs byas kyin 'dug pa de tsho skal ldan ma lus 'dren pa'i rtags su go /'obs nang gi mi long ba de tsho'i gseb nas phal che ba zhig bud med de la rgyab brten 'dug ste/ de tsho skal med log lta mkhan du go /lar blo dman pa dmus long lta bu tshos brda chos dang bshad chos tsho mi go ste/ bla mas bud med de la brda dang bshad pa la ma brten pa'i dmus long lta bu la/ rtogs pa 'char ba'i gdams ngag yod dam byas pas/ bud med de na re/ nga la med de/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi yum gyur ma chos kyi bdag mo khong la yod de/ dmus long de khang thog tu 'dren pa/ skal ldan lta bu'i gdams ngag sems can sangs rgyas su btsan thabs su 'drong ba/ rgod po tshang bsnyag pa lta bu'i gdams ngag yod pas shing sha pa'i sdong po'i rtsar phyin nas/ maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol ba btab na gnang bar nges zer nas mi snang bar yal song ba dang*/ bla mas shing sha ba'i rtsar phyin te maṇ+ḍal phul gsol ba btab pa'i dus su/

nub cig nam mkha'i mthong thams cad 'ja' dang 'od kyis khengs mchod pa dpag tu med pa phul ba dang*/ rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs pa 'khrol zhing 'dug pa gzigs/ de'i dus su nam mkha'i mthong na mar la lus med pa'i bu mo lo bcu drug tsam gcig gis skad byung ste/ kye kye tai lo (411)sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon// sems can dmus long ma lus pa// thar pa'i lam la 'di ltar khrid// gsungs nas/ sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu dang*// 'pho ba don gyi grong 'jug gnang*// 'di las zab pa'i chos med pas// khyod nas brgyud pa bzhi yi bar// phyogs phyogs rnams su gcig brgyud bya// de rjes kha ba can gyi byang phyogs su// byang chub sems dpa' 'tsho byed gzhon nu 'byung*// de nas skal ldan dad ldan rnams la spel// chos bdag bde ster ma yis byed// lus med lus te lus kyi mchog /de don go ba kun la gces// gsungs te/ mkha' 'gro'i lus mi gsal yang*/ 'ja' 'od rol mo'i sgra rnams o rgyan gyi phyogs su gshegs so// de nas bla ma gtsug gi nor bu'i dgon par byon// nā ro pa la gdams ngag 'di'i bka' gtad pa tsam gyis don dam pa zhig go ste/ sems kyi spros pa der chod do// bla mas mar pa mi la/ sgam po pa rnams snod ldan du lung bstan/ de nas byang chub sems dpa'i brgyud pa za bam tshags su 'ong bar mkhyen te/ dgyes pa'i tshul gyis tshogs 'khor bshams/ gar mdzad/ mgur yang mang zhig tu gsungs/ ri ri pa la gdams ngag de nyid kyi bka' gtad nas/ sring mo bde ster mas rgya gar li yul nas 'di len mkhan cig pos yong ba yod pas/ khyod kyis byin cig gsungs/ bla mas ka so ri pa la nub phyogs o rgyan gyi yul ngos la/ khyod kyis gdams ngag 'di gnyis bskyal dgos gsungs pas/ ga nas byung cha med par rtsa der bud med mi sdug pa cig byung nas/ gad mo chen po cig dgod cing 'dug ste/

ci la dgod byas pas/ gser gyi yul du gser dam du bskyel du btang (412)yang*/ ya mtshan cher mi yong ba de la dgod pa yin zer bas/ dngos la spel mkhan mi dgos par go /de nas bla ma nā ro pa pu l+la ha ri la byon/ yon tan dpag tu med pa la brten te/ las can gyi slob ma yang mang du 'dus/ khyad par bla ma mar pa bod la byon te/ zhu ba pos zhu shes pa/ gsung ba pos gsung shes pa mdzad na/ gang la gang mkho'i chos zab mo rnams byin te/ bod du gdul bya la btang*/ rgya gar nas zab chos mang po lon pa'i kha skad kyang byung*/ las can gyi slob ma yang mang du 'dus/ khong gi chos rnams bod du spel bas/ bla ma la phrag dog byed pa'i chos pa rnams na re/ bsgoms pas sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag khyed min pa la yang yod/ khyed kyi bla ma nā ro pa min pa la yang yod/ ma bsgoms par sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag yod na khyed kyang khyad par 'phags/ khyed kyi bla ma nā ro yang khyad par 'phags zer bas/ bla ma mar pa'i thugs dgongs la/ nga'i bla ma nā ro pa de gang la yang mnga' brnyes pas/ ma bsgoms par sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag cig yod par thag chod pas/ nga rang zhu ba pos zhu mkhas par dod kyang zhu ma shes par 'dug snyam ste/ khong rang gi zhing gcig kyang btsongs/ slob ma la yang gser khral cig kyang btab nas/ gser bram ze'i bu mo lo bco lnga lon pa zhig gi ka pā la snying phyur re ba zhig khyer nas/ rgya gar du byon pa'i dus su/ bla ma nā ro pa spyod pa la gshegs nas yun ring du ma rnyed/ rnyed pa'i dus su phyag 'tshal/ skor ba bskor/ zhabs spyi bos blangs nas gser ka pā la gang po de phul ba'i dus su/ bka' bkyon byon te/ mar pa lo tsā khyed bod du 'gro don gyis byas pa'i 'di na tshur ci byed gsungs nas/ phyag kyang bcug pa la/ zhu ba byas pa la/ nga yong ba'i don byung*/ khyed rang gis chos zab mo mang po gnang ba ngas bod du spel bas/

bod kyi chos pa tsho na re/ bsgoms nas sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag khyod min pa su la yang yod/ khyod kyi bla ma nā ro pa min pa la yang yod/ ma bsgoms par sangs (413)rgyas pa'i gdams ngag yod na khyod kyang khyad par 'phags/ khyod kyi bla ma nā ro pa yang khyad par du 'phags pa yin zer bar/ nga yi bsam pa la/ bla ma rin po che nyid gang la yang mnga' brnyes pas/ ma bsgoms par sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag yod par thag chod pas/ len pa la yong ba yin lags zhus pas/ bla ma nā ro pa de nyid kyis kyang bod la dmigs pa'i phyag dgu phrugs zhig 'tshal nas/ ngo mtshar che bod na chos pa yod par 'dug /ma bsgoms par sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag los yod gsungs nas/ pu la ha rir khrid nas/ zab mo tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor/ mkha' 'gro rnams la gsol ba btab nas sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu 'di dang*/ 'pho ba don gyi grong 'jug gnyis gnang*/ de'i dus su bud med mi sdug pa zhig byung nas/ spra ba gang bu gcig gi nang na me zhig bcug ste/ bla ma mar pa'i phyag tu btad byung bas nang gi me de phyes pas sbra ba de thul gyis tshigs song ba dang*/ nā ro pa'i gsung gis go'am gsung pa dang*/ sgro 'dogs nang nas chod zer ba go lags zhus pa dang*/ yang bud med des/ dmus long cig lag pas khrid song ste/ skas la rim gyis khrid de thog khar bskyal song bas/ bla ma'i gsung gis go'am gsungs/ khrid 'di rim pa legs par brtsegs dgos par go lags zhus pa dang*/ bla mas phyag spyi bor bzhag ste/ bkra shis brjod me tog 'thor/ de nas tshur bod la byon nas chu bo gaṅgā brgal ba'i dus su dbu bsnyung bzhes pa la/ rgya gar gyi chu bo gaṅgā tshun chod du chos 'di las zab pa 'grim re/ phan chod du lhag ma lus re gsungs/ de nas bod du byon bro bo lung gi dgon par byon nas/ las can gyi slob ma mang du 'dus/ ma (414)bsgoms par sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag 'di gnyis/

bla mas mi la la ster dgos pa'i lung bstan yod kyang*/ bla ma mar pa'i thugs dgongs la/ nga'i 'di dar ma mdo sde la ster/ dar ma mdo sdes sgam po pa la ster du 'jug dgos snyam nas/ dar ma mdo sde la ster par thag bcad pa dang*/ dngos dang rmi lam gang la yang mkha' 'gro ma'i bar chad byung ste dar ma mdo sde grongs so// sgyu lus kyi grong 'jug de byin yod pas/ yag por byung*/ khong rang yang grongs la khad pa'i bar chad byung*/ sras grongs pa'i thugs mi bde ba che bar byung ba'i dus su/ bud med shin tu mi sdug pa zhig byung nas/ bla ma'i bka' bzhin ma bsgrub na/ sems la bde ba ci la yod// zer te mi snang bar yal song ba dang*/ bla mas dmar gtor cha lnga bshams nas/ mkha' 'gro ma la bzod gsol dang bshags pa byas/ mi la las can gyi slob mar gzigs kyang*/ lo gsum jo mo'i g.yog po bcol snyam yang*/ da 'di la gdams ngag tsho'i bka' byin nas/ 'gro don la brdzang dgos par 'dug dgongs nas/ dbang bka' dang chos bka' yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ grong 'jug gnyis kyis sna drangs pa'i chos bka' thams cad gtad pa tsam gyis rgyud smin grol du song*/ sgro 'dogs thams cad chod/ ma bsgoms par sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag 'di gnyis la/ sngon bskal pa grangs med pa'i sngon rol nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ smon lam tshan po che btab pa zhig nyi ma shar phyogs ma ki nas len mkhan 'ong ba yod pas/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la spel du chug /khyod slob ma'i tshogs bsags pa yin gsungs/ der chos bka' rnams byin pa dang*/ bla ma mar pa yang sku khams dwangs/ de nas bla ma mi la yul du byon te/ rdzong drung la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su bzhugs/ la phyi chu bar gnyis na bzhugs yod pa'i dus su/ bla ma mi (415)la'i spyan sngar las can gyi slob bu mang du 'dus kyang nub cig rmi lam na/ bud med mi sdug pa cig byung nas/

nga 'tsho byed gzhon nu 'bod du 'gro zer nas/ gad mo chen po dgod kyin 'dug pas/ bla mas 'tsho byed gzhon nu su la zer byas pas/ dbus pa ston pa la zer ba yin ces yang gad mo rgod kyin 'dug /bla ma rnal sad tsam na/ rmi lam de rgod re bro/ lung bstan zin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de 'ong ba yin te 'ong snyam nas/ de ring sang dbus ma gi na ston pa zhig 'ong bar yod gsungs pas/ bla ma la yon bdag mo legs ses chang drangs nas/ ston pa de 'gro don yong ngam zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ bcom ldan 'das de nyid nyi ma lta bu/ dbus pa ston pa de nyid zla ba lta bu de bzhin yin gsungs/ de nas thog cig tu dbus pa ston pa bla ma'i spyan sngar byon no// thugs yid gnyis su med par 'dres te/ dbang dang gdams pa yang mang du gnang*/ bla ma'i spyan sngar yang yun ring du bsdad/ 'byon khar sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu 'di dang*/ 'pho ba don gyi grong 'jug 'di gnyis gnang nas rgyud thams cad smin grol la song*/ 'gro don tshad med pa'i rten 'brel shar/ bla mas 'tsho byed gzhon nu lung bstan/ de bzhin yin yang dus ngan pas/ chos pa gzhan rnams kyi blo ngor sbas pa'i ngang du sdod zhus pas/ 'o na de tshug 'thad gsungs nas/ sgam po pa ru btags/ sgam po'i lung bstan zhib par mdzad/ sgam po lung bstan pa'i mgur gsungs/ de steng dbus su 'ong se ba lung la sogs pa'i dben gnas mang po zhig tu sgrub pa lo shes byas/ de nas thabs kyis sgam por byon/ las can gyi slob ma mang po 'dus/ (416)yongs su rdzogs pa stong kha bud pa'i dus su/ da lta dus bzang bas bsgom nus par gda'/ snyan brgyud dang chos drug 'dis mchog pa mi 'dug /sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu 'di dang*/ 'pho ba don gyi grong 'jug 'di gnyis kyi bstan srung la trag shad thal mo gcig chog 'di dgos so// slob dpon pad+ma'i lung bstan 'di la bltas na bsgom long med par sangs rgyas pa'i gdams ngag 'di gnyis/

snyigs ma'i dus su dgos par 'dug snyam ste/ sgam po ga dar gyi rgyab tu mtsho maṇ+ḍal nag po'i nang du gter du sbas/ 'di sbas dge ba'i rtsa ba des 'gro ba ma lus bla med byang chub thob par shog // dge'o// sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so// ༈ //rgya gar skad du/ kā ya a pa ṇi ḍā ki nī sā dha nā ma/ bod skad du/ lus med mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs// dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di btsan thabs su sgrub pa yin pas/ thob pas sangs rgyas pa'i sems khrid yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ thos pas sangs rgyas pa 'pho ba don gyi grong 'jug gnyis las/ 'dir sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu ston par byed de// de la/ dang po gnas 'ju gtan la phab/ de rjes rig pa ther la 'don// gnyis med chen po'i ngo sprod bya// dgra bcom dmigs pa rags la bskor// bsgom med brda yi ngo sprod bya// shes bya'i sgrib pa 'dag lung bstan// rtags yon tan 'char de blta bar bya// zhes pas/ dang po gnas pa gtan la dbab pa ni/ gzhi gtan la 'beb pa yin te/ skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi steng du lhod de bzhag /de gang zag gi rgyud la 'jug tsa na gnas pa gtan la phab pa yin te/ de'i steng du gnas na bsgom du btub la/ 'phro na bsgom du mi btub pas/ 'gyu ba gtan la dbab/ 'gyu ba 'di lam yin/ 'gyu ba phrol gyis skyes pa de rang la cer (417)gyis blta/ gzugs dang kha dog 'dug gam/ 'gro sa 'ong sa gnas sa 'dug gam bltas pas/ ye nas ma grub pa'i don gyis skye med du zhi 'gro/ gnas pa'i steng du lhan ne phebs pa de 'gyu ba gtan la phebs pa yin/ gnas pa'i ngo bor skye med chos skur gnas pa de dang*/ rnam rtog gi ngo bo skye med las phul sa mi 'dug pas/ 'di gnyis gcig par 'dug gam blta/ gnas su ma btub na dang po byung sa med pa'i ched du 'gyu ru bcug

/'gol sar nan gyis bsgom du bcug pas mi gnas mi srid do// 'gyu ru ma btub na gcig byung na bsgom du mi btub pas/ 'gyu ba gcig kyang ma byung ba gyis shig byas la 'gol sar khrid la nan gyis bsgom du bcug pas 'gyu ba zin 'ong la de'ang gnyis su med pa'i don gyis gcig tu thag chod 'ong*/ des gnas skabs su 'bras bu'i go ba rnyed pa yin/ gnas 'gyu gtan la phebs nas/ rig pa ther la 'don pa 'di la/ rnam rtog gcig chos skur 'dug na kun chos skur 'dug gam blta/ gcig ngo bos stong na kun ngo bos stong pas 'gyu ru bcug /shar du bcug /rnam rtog thams cad chu nang du char babs pa bzhin du skyes grol dus mnyam la 'gro/ rnam rtog 'dul dka' ba yang byung na/ dka' shos de la rtsa gdar nan gyis bcad/ rnam rtog thams cad gcig la tshad pa 'dra ba thams cad bde 'jam la dkrigs kyis song tsam na/ rnam rtog bsgom du shar ba/ rig pa ther 'thon pa'i tshad yin no// gnyis med chen po'i ngo sprod 'di la/ dbang po rab kyis gnas 'gyu gnyis gcig tu shes pa dang*/ kun rdzob la 'phrig tshud nas skyong thog tu lus sems gnyis med du nyams su blangs pa'i shugs kyis snang stong gnyis med du (418)rtogs/ nang du rig pa ma lus/ phyi ru bem po ma lus/ bem rig gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs nas du ma ro gcig tu thag chod pa 'ong*/ tha ma rnams kyi gnas 'gyu gcig par go yang*/ kun rdzob la 'phrig ma tshud pas/ 'di'i thad kar bem rig gnyis med kyi ngo sprod bya/ rdzogs rim kun gyi lung yang drang*// kyai nang na sems med na/ phyi ru gzugs 'ong ba'i don med/ stong pa med na snang ba med// snang ba thams cad med/ blo chung ba rnams ltar na/ kun rdzob don dam gnyis su med par 'dogs kyang*/ gnas skabs su gzung 'dzin gyi bcings pa grol nas/ gzugs 'di btsal bas rnyed pa med/ bltas pas mthong ba med/

kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis su med do// lar 'dzin med kyi mtha' la skyol cig /'khor 'das rang sar grol bar 'gro ba yin// chos thams cad gcig tu rtogs pa'o// dgra bcom pa'i dmigs pa ni/ dgra ni rnam rtog 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'o// bcom pa ni 'dzin med rang sar grol ba'o// sa gdon gnod pa'i dmigs pa ni zhal las shes so// zhes pa ni/ dgra bcom dmigs pa yan chad bde mer khyug gis song ba dang*/ lus tha mal du gnas pa'i lte 'og tu hūm̐ mar me'i rang bzhin can cig la me dmar 'u ru ru chi li li 'bar te/ lus kyi nang thams cad thu lu lu bsreg par bsgom/ me lce phyir chad de phyi yang thul ba sreg /de las kyang mched pas gnas khang yang bsregs par bsam/ sbal sbrul la sogs phyir ma thon bar du nan tan bya'o// des tshur gnod pa'i rtags byung na khrid kyi dmigs pa sngar bzhin yang bskyang bar bya zhing*/ nan tan bde mor song ba dang*/ me dmigs gong ltar byas pas sa gdon thon pa'i rtags 'byung*/ thon pa'i rtags ma byung gi bar la res 'jog bya/ de ltar byas pas thon par the tshom med/ gang zag mchog rnams kyis gnas 'gyu gcig tu rtogs pa dang*/ rnam rtog phra rags sgom (419)gsum skye grol la song ba dus mnyam/ rtsal 'bring gis bem rig gnyis med du rtogs pa dang*/ rnam rtog phra rags sbom gsum skye grol la song ba dus mnyam/ gang zag tha mal rnams la lus sems gnyis mi 'dug na/ phra mo dang sbom po skye grol du e 'gro brtag /'gro na rags pa skye grol du mi 'gro ba'i don med/ ngo bo stong pa'i sgo nas khyad par med pas nang du sems tshol du mi 'dug na/ phyi na lus 'dug gam lta ru gzhug /lus sems mi 'dug na/ phyi rol gyi snang ba yong 'dug gam blta ru gzhug /thams cad ngo bos stong na rnam rtog rags pa skyes nas gnas sa 'gro sa 'dug gam brtag /de bzhin du brtags pas ji ltar mi bde ba tsho yang skyes grol dang skye med du lhan lhan zhi 'gro/

gang zag gis blo dang bstun cing nan tan dang thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas 'dzin pa bshig go /sgom med kyi dmigs pa ni tshogs drug snang ba thams cad bde lhan lhan 'char zhing 'dug na/ de snang ba sgom du shar ba yin/ de'i thad ka na 'khrul rtog ni med/ snang ba sgom du shar rgyu de rang 'dag dgos pas brda'i sgo nas ngo sprod pa ni/ rang gi mig g.yas zur gyi gzugs shig la cer bltas snang stong gnyis med gzug 'dzin dang stong 'dzin gyi cha med par snang stong gnyis med du bde phril ler 'dug na/ mig g.yas spo g.yon spo drag tu bya/ g.yas su bltas tsam na g.yas kyi gzugs 'char bar 'dug gam/ g.yon gyi gzugs nub par 'dug gam blta/ g.yon du bltas tsam na/ g.yon gyi gzugs 'char bar 'dug gam/ g.yas kyi gzugs nub par 'dug blta/ de ltar bltas pas gzugs 'dzin dang stong 'dzin gyi cha med kyang shar nub kyi cha bag (420)re 'dug na 'dzin pa yin pas thad ka'i skyon bsal/ gzugs 'dzin dang stong 'dzin dang phyogs ris thams cad nam mkha' dkyil bzhin du gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis su med par yod pas/ thad ka'i skyon btsan thabs su bsal/ gzugs 'dzin dang stong 'dzin dang phyogs ris thams cad nam mkha'i dkyil bzhi ma bde 'jam la song nas/ 'di bzhin nyams su blang bar bya/ ma rtogs pa'i dus na gzugs sna tshogs su snang yang*/ rtogs pa'i dus na ngo bo cir yang ma grub/ shar nub dang phyogs ris gang yang ma grub pas gong gi dmigs pa tshar re re bzhin nyams su blang zhing*/ sgom mkhan 'dug gam/ bsgom rgyu 'dug gam/ nyams su blang bya 'dug gam/ nyams su myong ba 'dug gam/ de ltar bltas pas/ snang ba rang sar dag nas kyang*/ bsgom du 'char rgyu'i cha gyi na tsam gcig yod par bzung 'dug gam/ lus sems med pa'i bsgom 'char rgyu mi 'ong snyam pa'i don rtogs pa dang*/ gzugs la rtog cing dmigs pa spar tsam bya/

de ltar byas pas sgom gyi don rtogs shing brtan pa 'thob par 'gyur ro// shes bya'i sgrib pa la dag pa ni/ don la blo 'das yin kyang*/ blo dang chos kyi cha bag re tsam yod par shes pa de shes bya'i sgrib pa yin/ de dag par byed pa la/ gong ma rnams dmigs pa'i rten tu ma zad slar dmigs pas bogs 'don te/ 'dir dmigs pa dang bsgom gyi bogs 'don pa rnams 'byung*/ dag pa'i cha phra mo zhig dgos par byung na/ de la thabs kyis bogs 'don no// 'di'i thad ka la spang bya med kyang*/ yul kha brgyud rgyu'i gyi na tsam cig yod/ blo dang chos kyi cha phra mo re skabs skabs su rgyad rgyad 'ong*/ de dag par byed pa la/ dge mi dge lung ma bstan gsum gyi bsam mno btang du (421)bcug /des las sogs mi sogs dang*/ sgom du 'gro mi 'gro'i cha phra mo gyi na tsam 'dug na/ shes bya'i dmigs pa thad kar ma rtogs pas/ gong ma'i dmigs pa tsho re re la nan tan byed du bcug /las sogs mi sogs dang*/ sgom du 'gro mi 'gro'i rtsis gdab mi 'dug na/ zol mi 'jog par rig pa'i sna khrid nas rang 'jug 'phros na mnyam par bzhug /'di'i thad ka na spang bya ni med/ ngo bo gzhi thog na rjen ne 'dug na rjes shes yin// gong gi bsam blo lu gu brgyud byung bas mi chog /ched du 'phro ru 'jug pa yin// de ltar byas pas rig pa'i rten 'brel gyi cha la/ sgrib pa'i shan shun rnams lhod kyis glod nas stong yang stong*/ zad kyang zad 'gro/ don la lcags zad pa dar gser zad/ rgyu zad spun zad/ rgyu zad rkyen zad la gtong ba yin/ de bzhin nyams su blangs pas/ blo zad chos zad rig pa rten med nam mkha'i dkyil bzhin khrol gyis 'gro/ 'gyu ba zad la gnas pa med pa zhig 'ong*/ de tsam na sgrub pa la rem pa thon na bya ba yin/ chos sku'i btsan sa zin no// gzugs sku rnam gnyis kyis snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don sgrub 'ong ngo*// a la la ho// rtags dang yon tan 'di la nges par 'char ba'i gang zag kyang 'ong*/

mi 'char ba'i gang zag kyang yod pas/ shar bas bzang du song ba med/ ma shar bas ngan du song ba med/ don la khyad med kyang 'char bar 'dod pa rnams la rang snang la 'char ram/ gzhan snang la 'char/ blo zad chos zad du song bas rtags gang nas 'char gyi mtha' brtag go /mi 'char bar 'dod pa rnams la rang snang la mi 'char ram/ gzhan du mi 'char/ rgyu rkyen gang gi sgo nas mi 'char gyi mtha' brtag go /de ltar byas pas 'char mi 'char gyi mtha' tsho (422)'ong*/ rtags ni 'char mi 'char la ma ltos par ngo bo mtha' bral du khres se song nas sems kyi ngo bo mthong bya ba yin te/ rtsa bral rtogs pa zad de mkhyen pa lhun gyis grub pa'o// lus med mkha' 'gro zhes bya ba'i sgrub thabs/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po nā ro paṇa chen dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pa lo tsās bsgyur ba'o// 'di 'debs pa'i gnas ni gangs ri dang rdza ri dang dur khrod dang mtha' 'khob dang bzhi'o// 'di dgon pa dang grong yul du btab na/ slob dpon rnams kyi tshe srog la gzan/ 'gro don la bar chad 'ong bas/ lung nas zin pa'i gnas su btang ngo*// de'ang sngon 'gro'i dus su sde lnga'i phyogs mtshon pa'i maṇ+ḍal bsham/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal gcig dang*/ mchod pa rnam lnga sang 'byor bsham/ gtor ma cha gsum bsham/ 'bul lugs spyi dang mthun pa la/ khyad par chos bdag mkha' 'gro sde lnga gter bdag jo bo rgya lhas sna drangs pa'i mtsho sman rgyal mo la sogs pa'i gter gyi kha byang gi gter bdag rnams dang*/ jo bo dwags lha sgam po la sogs gter gyi dngos gzhi'i gter bdag rnams la 'bul lo// rjes la gnas 'byung ngo sprod kyi dus su gtor ma cha lnga bsham/ 'bul lugs gong dang mthun/ ngo sprod chen mo'i dus su gtor ma gu ru lugs cha lnga bsham/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga la dpal gtor cha lnga bsham/ ma 'byor na gcig bsham/ gter bdag gnyis la btsan bshos re re bshams la 'bul/

yid bzhin nor bu 'di la phyag rten ma len/ chos sbyin du thongs/ khrid thon pa'i dus su snga ma legs pa'i gtang rag /phyi ma legs pa'i zhu don du gtor ma cha gsum mam cha lnga bshams la 'bul lo// 'bras bu btsan thabs su nyams su myong ba'i gdams ngag /sems khrid yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'di/ khrid thob pas chog pa yin pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gdams pa'i khrid yin/ byang chub sems dang mi ldan na// 'gro don mi 'byung srog la 'bab// yid bzhin nor bu'i (423)dpe 'di ni// khrid ma thob pa'i mis mthong na// dngos sam rmi lam dag tu ni// mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad mang po 'byung*// de go bar gyis la gsang bar mdzod// rang gi khrid btab kyi slob ma las dang skal ldan re re tsam ma gtogs pa/ gzhan la ma bstan bka' rgya'o// rgya rgya rgya/ sems khrid zhu mi khoms pa'i ban btsun dang*/ yon bdag pho mo bar do la 'jigs pa rnams la 'pho ba don gyi grong 'jug 'di bya/ gdams pa 'di gnyis kyis skal med log lta can ma gtogs pa/ dad pa dmig re yod pa rnams blo 'drong ba yin// dpe mi la ma bstan pa gal che/ sems khrid la 'phri bsnan dang rang bzo ma byed/ bla ma mkha' 'gro'i bka' rgya yod do// khrid 'debs lugs tsho bla ma'i zhal las shes gsung ngo*// 'di bris dge ba'i rtsa ba des// mkha' mnyam sems can ma lus pa// gnyis 'dzin 'ching ba las grol nas// gnyis med chen po'i don rtogs shog /shu bham/ ༈ /'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ lus med mkha' 'gro/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ dwags po lha rje/ skyes bu ye rdor/ dung mtsho ras pa/ 'khrul zhig chen po/ mtshan ldan chos dbyings dbang phyug /rin po che shes rab bzang po/ des bdag la'o// yang kun dga' rgyal mtshan pa/ des bdag go /'pho ba don gyi grong 'jug bzhugs/ na mo gu ru/ bsgoms pas sangs rgyas pa don khrid yid bzhin nor bu/

ma bsgoms pas sangs rgyas pa 'pho ba don gyi grong 'jug gnyis la/ phyi rabs kyi don du yi ger bris// na dgu cog ni mi 'chi ste// 'chi dgu cog ni na nas 'chi// rang gi rig pa 'di gal te rlung dang 'grogs nas thur la don gyur na/ (424)chos byas rnams kyang 'khor bar ltung*/ gal te rlung dang 'grogs nas gyen la don gyur na// sdig po che yang mngon sangs rgyas// 'pho ba 'di sems khrid yid bzhin nor bu thob pa dang*/ rtogs pa mtho ba rnams la mi dgos te/ 'on kyang dgos pa'i dus gnyis po bla ma'i zhal las shes so// 'di rtags tshang ba'i bar la dran tsam byas/ rtags tshang nas bem rig bral/ rtags mang yang 'dir ma 'dus

'chi rtags gsum bla ma'i zhal las shes/ pa med pa ni/ rang 'od mi 'dug na 'chi rtags tshang*/ rang sgra mi 'dug na 'chi rtags tshang*/ rang gzugs mi 'dug na 'chi rtags tshang*/ de ltar tshang 'dug na 'chi ba yin pas de'i dus su thos pas sangs rgyas pa 'pho ba don gyi grong 'jug 'di dgos/ 'di la dang po sngon 'gro sems bskyed kyis zin pa gal che/ lus ci bder bzhag /dngos gzhi la rang gang mos pa'i bla ma'i sku'am yi dam gyi skur gsal gdab/ dmigs pa gsal na sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs dang bcas pa bkra lam me bsgom/ dmigs pa mi gsal na bla ma'i sku yin no snyams pa'i mos pa drag po bya/ de'i ngang nas rang gi snying na/ rigs lnga'i sku khra spung nger 'dug par bsam/ dmigs pa gsal na/ dbus rnam par snang mdzad/ shar rdo rje sems dpa'// lhor rin chen 'byung ldan/ nub snang ba mtha' yas/ byang don yod grub pa rnams khra spung nge 'dug par bsam/ dmigs pa mi gsal na/ rigs lnga yin snyams pa'i gding bya/ de'i ngang nas snying ga nas spyi bo'i gtsug man chad bug pa zang thal le ba ya gi nas bltas na ma ki gsal ba/ ma ki nas bltas na ya ki gsal ba/ mkhar khang thog med pa lta bu skya had de ba zhig bsam/ de'i ngang nas rang gi sems mi dran dgu dran (425)'di/ skad cig gis a dkar po che chung bung ba tsam zhig bsam/ de'i ngang nas a dkar po des/ snying gar rgyal ba rigs lnga bzhugs pa de la g.yas skor du sga ra ra bskor bar bsam/ de'ang skor ba 'khor gsum mam lnga'am bdun nas rdza chag nang nas bye'u 'phur ba'am/ rtsal po ches nam mkha' la mda' 'phang ba bzhin tu/ a dkar po de nam mkha'i mthong la dkar rgyangs kyis song bar bsam/ de'i phyi la klad pa don snying rnam pa lnga/ nang rol dang bcas pa sangs nge song bar bsam/ a dkar po de yang nam mkha'i mthong la dkar rkyangs kyis song*/ khong hika gyi na tsam zhig byas pas 'og rlung 'then gyis song*/

kha rlung sna rlung thad ka na tshur mi btang bar hril hril dril la spyi bo'i tshangs pa'i bu ga 'phul lo// dbugs kyis thub tshad bsdus/ 'dar phri li li tshangs pa'i bu ga la 'phul lo// rlung mas yar 'phul ba tsam gyis a de nam mkha'i mthong la je mthor song bar bsam/ so sgra tog tog spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga la si sgra thon pa tsam du 'phul lo// rlung mi thub tshad byung na kha rlung sna rlung thad kar btang*/ yi ge a de mar log par bsam yang chog /ma gi na a gcig yod par bsam yang chog /yang rgyal ba rigs lnga la skor ba sga ra ra 'dug par bsam/ de yang skor ba gsum mam lnga'am bdun tsam byas nas/ yang a de nam mkha'i mthong la rgyangs kyis song bar bsam/ yang rlung gyen la mgo gas pa tsam du 'phul lo// de ltar lan kha yar byas pas/ shes pa ti tham gyis 'gro/ mgo sbrid chil gyis 'ong*/ spyir mgo thams cad na/ sgos su spyi gtsug na kam 'ong*/ de 'pho ba thebs pa yin/ de mang na zla ba re re la lan gsum/ nyung na lan gnyis/ ji ltar nyung yang (426)lan gcig gsal gdab/ rtogs pa mtho ba rnams la bsre ba 'di mi dgos/ dma' ba rnams la 'di ltar du bslab par bya/ gzhan tsho gong dang 'dra/ a dkar po de nam mkha'i mthongs su song bar bsam/ rlung gis 'phul mi bya/ nam mkha'i mthong la a skye ba med pa chos kyi sku/ a yang mi dmigs/ nam mkha' yang mi dmigs/ dbyings dang rig pa gnyis su med par krug gis bsres/ kun rdzob don dam gnyis med/ 'khor 'das gnyis med/ nam mkha'i dkyil bzhin du lhod de bzhag /dbyings dang rig pa gnyis su med pa'i ngang las rig pa dbang gtod la ji ltar gnas kyi bar la bzhag /de ltar bzhag pa'i ngang nas/ rtog pa 'phro 'phro byung na/ yang 'bad nas bsre bar bya/ rtog pa dma' ba rnams la 'di nan chen dga'/ shes mi shes byung na thad ka'i skyon bsal/ gong gi 'pho ba drags nas skyon byung na 'di ltar 'bad pa'i dmigs pa sna kha gsum dang po lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/

de'i lte 'og gsang gnas kyi gong tsam gyi khong pa'i nang du me'i a dmar po lcags zhun btang ba'i me ma'i mdog lta bu/ che chung tshon gang ba zhig la dmigs pa gtad pas/ a de las me 'bar te/ khong pa'i nang thams cad mas thol thol te/ nad gdon dang sdig sgrib thams cad thal gyis bsregs par bsam/ dmigs pa de yun ring du bzung*/ de bzhin byas pas phebs so// des kyang ma phebs na/ spyi gtsug tu mar dkar nag gang yong byugs la drogs tsam bya/ rkang mthil la yang byugs pa byas la/ rkang lag bar la me 'bar bdo ba tsam mnye'o// des phebs 'ong*/ gong gi a dmar po de rang gi mtshan ma'i nang nas thon te/ mdun gyi mtho gang gi thad kar a de dmar ram (427)gyis byung bar bsam/ gsal bdo tsam na rang gi mtshan ma'i nang nas tshur rgyangs kyis byung bar bsams la/ nang du dro bas dros la phyir rgyangs kyis song bar bsam/ da ci'i shul na dmar krong nge 'dug par bsam/ de bzhin yun ring du bya/ de ltar byas pas mi phebs mi srid do// 'di la lan cig thebs nas ma brjed pa tsam byed pa gal che'o// byed drags nas thal ba la tshegs med pas/ chang gis bzi ba dang*/ rlung shas che ba dang*/ gangs khrod lta bur gsal mi gdab/ yod pas chog pas 'pho ba yin no// 'dis dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum kar zin/ yang btsan thabs su dmigs pa bla ma'i zhal las shes so// dbang po tha ma'i tha ma la/ dmigs pa mi gdab bar do'i ngo sprod bya'o// ma shi'i bar la rang gi mig nang na rigs lnga'i sku 'ja' tshon gyis skor ba zhig yod pas/ de rang la ngo sprod bya'o// shi nas bar do'i dus zhag nyi shu tshun tshad bdun pa na chad/ lus med kyang bar do yid kyi lus can yin pas/ rang gi 'dom gang tsam gyi mdun gyi nam mkha' la/ rigs lnga'i sku rang gi mig gi nang de bas kyang gsal ba zhig /skabs su 'ja' dang 'od kyi rnam pa sga ra ra yod/ de rigs lnga'i skur shes pa tsam gyis bar dor sangs rgyas 'thob bo// de ltar rigs lnga yab yum gyi ngo sprod sgo'i lam khyer zhib tu bstan/

bar do'i rig pa dgu 'gyur gyis gsal du 'gro bas/ da lta bstan pa tsam gyis rang ngo rang gis shes pas bar do khegs so// dud 'gro dang nad pa dmigs pa mi shes pa rnams la 'debs na dmigs pa tsho rang gis bzung*/ mi min na mgo thog tu rten gyi rigs spyi gtsug tu sbyar la bzhag /dmigs pa rang res ji ltar gsal bar 'phul lo// dbyugs chad 'dug na mgo thog tu (428)rten bzhag mi dgos so// drod ma yal bar 'dug na dmigs pa 'phul drag po bya'o// spyi gtsug tu sngar ma thon pa la sen btsugs la sogs pa bya'o// dud 'gro dpral bar gtsug yod pa rnams la/ gtsug de rang la sen btsug gam khu tshur brdeg go/ /gtsug med pa rnams la rwa ba ra du bya/ rwa med pa la de'i thad kar sen tsag gam khur ram/ rdo dang shing la sogs pas tug tug bya/ dmigs pa mi dang 'dra ste/ gang la'ang gsal la drag tu 'phul lo// 'di ltar byas pas thebs pa'i rtags nam mkha' la 'ja' dang 'od kyis khengs pa'am/ spyi bor rlangs pa bun pa'am/ snum pa la sogs pa 'byung ngo*// ro grang thag chod pa min pa gang la'ang mi thebs pa mi yong*/ 'di 'debs pa'i zhing ni 'di rnams so// 'gro don chen po 'ong ba'i rigs rnams so// grwa sa chen po'i ban btsun gyi rigs rnams so// yon bdag pho mo dad pa can rnams dang ar khrid dang sgom med pa rnams la sbyin no// 'di 'debs pa'i dus su mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sku'am/ ras bris sam/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du phyogs tshon lta bur gcig bsham gtor ma tshogs 'khor bya/ 'di la gser gyi maṇ+ḍal la sogs rgyu dang bstun la 'bul du gzhug /'di sgur skyon can dang*/ snying rlung can dang*/ sems gcong can la mi sbyin no// mkha' 'gro rnams kyi dmigs pa gcig tu dril ba/ 'khor ba btsan thabs su gcod pa 'pho ba don gyi grong 'jug 'di/ snyigs mar phan phyir gter du sbas// 'gro ba ma lus drang bar shog
// rgya rgya rgya/ sarba dā maṅga laṃ/// /
